zh.title: 你在指挥一支会不断校准的临时团队
zh.summary: 这是一段合成示例：18 个主会话带出 32 个子智能体。它呈现的是持续分派、检查和调整的协作习惯，最长活跃段为 126 分钟。

recommendations.title: 给每次分派补一个交付契约
recommendations.body: 只写三件事：角色、输出格式、验收动作。主线程会更容易合并结果。

recommendations.title: 长段工作中间插入可见验证
recommendations.body: 每完成一个里程碑就运行测试、构建或截图，别把所有验证留到最后。

recommendations.title: 短提示词只多补一个完成标准
recommendations.body: 不用把提示词写成长规格，只要补上相关文件、完成条件或验证方式中的一个。

en.title: You conduct a temporary team through continuous calibration
en.summary: This synthetic example has 18 main sessions and 32 subagents. It shows a habit of delegating, checking, and adjusting, with the longest run lasting 126 minutes.

recommendations.title: Add a small contract to every delegation
recommendations.body: Name the role, output format, and acceptance check so the main thread can merge results cleanly.

recommendations.title: Put visible checks inside long work sessions
recommendations.body: Run a test, build, or screenshot check at each milestone instead of saving every verification step for the end.

recommendations.title: Add one finish line to a short prompt
recommendations.body: Keep the prompt compact, then add one relevant file, success condition, or verification method.
